parentId.description:
The parent content ID of the page. If the `root-level` query parameter is set to false and a value is 
not supplied for this parameter, then the space homepage's ID will be used. If the `root-level` query 
parameter is set to true, then a value may not be supplied for this parameter.

subtype.description: The subtype of the page. Provide the subtype live to create a live doc or no subtype to create a page.

status.description: The status of the page, current or draft.

title.description: The updated title for the page

status.description:
The updated status of the page.

Note, if you change the status of a page from 'current' to 'draft' and it has an existing draft, the existing draft will be deleted in favor of the updated draft.
Additionally, this endpoint can be used to restore a 'trashed' or 'deleted' page to 'current' status. For restoration, page contents will not be updated and only the page status will be changed.

spaceId.description:
ID of the containing space.

This currently **does not support moving the page to a different space**.

parentId.description:
ID of the parent content.

This allows the page to be moved under a different parent within the same space.

ownerId.description:
Account ID of the page owner.

This allows page ownership to be transferred to another user.

number.description:
The new version of the updated page. 
Set this to the current version number plus one, unless you are updating the status to 'draft' which requires a version number of 1.

If you don't know the current version number, use Get page by id.

message.description: An optional message to be stored with the version.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the content was last updated.

cleanHistory.description: Whether to clean up previous versions containing the redaction. When true, historical versions of the content that contain the redacted text will be squashed.

versionNumber.description:
Optional version number of the content to redact. When specified, the redaction will target 
a specific historical version of the content rather than the current version.

- If omitted or null, the redaction applies to the current (latest) version of the content.
- When provided, must be a valid version number that exists for the content.

**Note**: Version numbers start at 1 and increment with each content update.

alias.description: This field will be used as the new identifier for the space in confluence page URLs. If the alias property is not provided, the key property is required to be used instead. Maximum 255 alphanumeric characters in length.

description.description: The description of the new/updated space. Note, only the 'plain' representation is currently supported.

items.description: The role assignments for the new space. If none are provided, the Default Space Roles are applied. If roles are provided, the space is created with exactly the provided set of roles. A private space is created if only the creator is assigned to a role and it’s the Admin role. At least one Admin role assignment must be specified.
